faq.0.a: The models fit the vast majority of standard and security doors. Send us a photo of your current lock and we confirm compatibility, no strings attached.
faq.1.a: The lock warns you weeks in advance in the app and on the device itself. And if it ever ran out, you can always open it with a power bank over USB-C or with the emergency physical key.
faq.1.q: What happens if the battery runs out?
faq.2.a: It uses bank-grade encryption, a tamper alarm and automatic locking. Unlike a key, a code or a fingerprint cannot be copied at a hardware shop.
faq.3.a: No. They all work on their own with a fingerprint or a code. WiFi is only needed if you want remote opening and phone alerts.
faq.3.q: Do I need WiFi at home?
